headline: Global Tensions Persist; Bond Yields Climb; Tech Security Concerns Emerge
summary: Geopolitical concerns dominated, with President Trump rejecting an Iran peace deal and the US reaching a tariff agreement with China. Bond yields continued their ascent, impacting real estate, while a software glitch affected Boeing's 737 MAX. Oracle's PeopleSoft faced expanded hacker attacks.

bullets.lead: President Trump rejected a peace deal with Iran, maintaining geopolitical tensions.

segments.text: The US President rejected a seven-day peace deal aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz, indicating ongoing conflict.

sources.title: Trump rejects Iran’s seven-day peace deal to reopen strait of Hormuz

segments.text: This rejection follows previous reports questioning the veracity of claims regarding a "biggest oil deal in world history" related to Iran.

sources.title: The truth behind Donald Trump’s ‘biggest oil deal in world history’

bullets.lead: The US and China finalized a significant tariff agreement.

segments.text: A $30 billion tariff deal was reached between the U.S. and China following a summit between President Trump and President Xi.

sources.title: U.S., China reach $30 billion tariff deal after Trump-Xi summit

segments.text: The absence of a CEO entourage with Xi Jinping at the summit may signal evolving dynamics in China-US relations.

sources.title: Xi Jinping Didn’t Bring a CEO Entourage. What That Says About China-US Relations.
